findings.name: audio-runtime-c79-retire-cli-response-lifecycle
findings.rejection_feedback: Reviewed PR #470 at head c23acde29231bda381603c72c45cb04dd7e999d3. Code defects block merge: (1) sessiondiagnostics/internal/service/continuation.go:61-89 computes Candidate without consulting activePurpose, so a tool-acknowledgement response returns Candidate=true; Observation.Admitted is never set. Enforce purpose at terminal admission and add a public regression. (2) response.go:23-44 retires the active ID and accepts a different EventResponseOpen while the prior response is still active; reject foreign/out-of-order opens unless an explicit terminal/continuation boundary permits replacement. (3) service.go:144-159 clears retired IDs on Reset, and continuation.go reopens inactive IDs, so an old response end after Reset reclaims a new lifecycle; preserve generation/stale-ID ownership and add the reset-late-event regression. (4) The CLI still owns an independent toolContinuationState and completion/failure/obligation decisions in session_diagnostics_tools.go:12-30,78-120,138-237,322-501; session_diagnostics_response.go:130-147 rehydrates it with OR-merging, while session_response_admission.go:68-79 and session_liveness.go:125-139 consume it. This violates the thin-adapter boundary and permits reducer/adapter disagreement. Move lifecycle decisions and queries to the service, remove the local lifecycle map/projection, and test reset/overlap behavior. Executor must repair these findings, refresh affected evidence, commit/push the new head, and resubmit once to SCRIPT CI; do not merge current head.
